decision.reasoning_trace: I began by filtering out the accessory items (cases, straps, and chargers) to focus on actual Bluetooth speakers. My consideration set includes a range of products from premium audiophile options like the Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1 to more budget-friendly rugged choices like the INSMY. I also included the Sony SRS-XB43 and both the new and renewed versions of the JBL Charge series, as they are market leaders for durability and sound. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it holds the highest rating in the set (4.8) with an extremely high volume of reviews (over 16,000), making it the most reliable choice for a balance of power, battery life, and durability.
